package main

// THROWAWAY oracle generator for RB12-TS-SURFACE (never committed): runs reportFinalityFile / printReport of the validator at
// cbb6373 over the cases of finality_test.go and finality_e2e_pos_test.go and records the exit code and text for the TypeScript twin.

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/finality"
	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/finality/adiri"
	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/finality/allkinds"
	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/finality/arbfinal/synthworld"
	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/finality/arbposted"
	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/finality/basefinal"
	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/finality/baseposted"
	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/finality/finalitytest"
)

type genCase struct {
	ID         string `json:"id"`
	Family     string `json:"family"`
	Doc        string `json:"doc,omitempty"`
	DocFile    string `json:"doc_file,omitempty"`
	Settlement string `json:"settlement"` // name of settlements/<name>.json, "" = none
	Chain      string `json:"chain"`
	Registry   string `json:"registry"` // fake_base | empty | all
	Pins       string `json:"pins"`     // embedded | <leg name> (pins/<name>.json)
	Kind       string `json:"kind"`     // the leg kind of a real-evidence case ("" otherwise)
	ExpectAll  genRun `json:"expect_all"`
	// ExpectWithout is the same run with a registry that lacks arb-sepolia/finalized/v1 and eth-sepolia/finalized/v1 (the kinds the TypeScript verifier does not have at this base)
	ExpectWithout genRun `json:"expect_without"`
}

type genRun struct {
	Exit int    `json:"exit"`
	Text string `json:"text"`
}

type genSynth struct {
	ID     string `json:"id"`
	Report any    `json:"report"`
	Expect genRun `json:"expect"`
	Note   string `json:"note"`
}

type synthState struct {
	Code   string         `json:"code"`
	Fields map[string]any `json:"fields"`
}
type synthLevel struct {
	Status string      `json:"status"`
	State  *synthState `json:"state,omitempty"`
}
type synthFinBlock struct {
	Number    uint64 `json:"number"`
	Hash      string `json:"hash"`
	StateRoot string `json:"stateRoot"`
}
type synthReport struct {
	Chain       uint64                `json:"chain"`
	Number      uint64                `json:"number"`
	Hash        string                `json:"hash"`
	Unsupported *synthState           `json:"unsupported,omitempty"`
	Levels      map[string]synthLevel `json:"levels"`
	Headline    string                `json:"headline"`
	Broken      *synthState           `json:"broken,omitempty"`
	FinBlockSt  *synthState           `json:"finalizedBlockState,omitempty"`
	FinBlock    *synthFinBlock        `json:"finalizedBlock,omitempty"`
	PinsSHA     string                `json:"pinsSha256"`
	PinsSource  string                `json:"pinsSource"`
}

func lvl(s string) finality.Level {
	switch s {
	case "included":
		return finality.LevelIncluded
	case "l1_posted":
		return finality.LevelL1Posted
	case "finalized":
		return finality.LevelFinalized
	}
	return finality.LevelNone
}

func stOf(s *synthState) *finality.StateError {
	if s == nil {
		return nil
	}
	var kv []any
	for k, v := range s.Fields {
		switch x := v.(type) {
		case int:
			kv = append(kv, k, uint64(x))
		default:
			kv = append(kv, k, v)
		}
	}
	return finality.NewState(s.Code, kv...)
}

func toReport(s synthReport) finality.Report {
	h, _ := hex.DecodeString(s.Hash)
	var hash [32]byte
	copy(hash[:], h)
	rep := finality.Report{Block: finality.BlockRef{Chain: s.Chain, Number: s.Number, Hash: hash}, Levels: map[finality.Level]finality.LevelStatus{}, Headline: lvl(s.Headline), PinsSHA256: s.PinsSHA, PinsSource: s.PinsSource}
	rep.Unsupported = stOf(s.Unsupported)
	rep.Broken = stOf(s.Broken)
	rep.FinalizedBlockState = stOf(s.FinBlockSt)
	for name, l := range s.Levels {
		rep.Levels[lvl(name)] = finality.LevelStatus{Status: finality.Status(l.Status), State: stOf(l.State)}
	}
	if s.FinBlock != nil {
		var fb finality.FinalizedBlock
		fb.Number = s.FinBlock.Number
		a, _ := hex.DecodeString(s.FinBlock.Hash)
		b, _ := hex.DecodeString(s.FinBlock.StateRoot)
		copy(fb.Hash[:], a)
		copy(fb.StateRoot[:], b)
		rep.FinalizedBlock = &fb
	}
	return rep
}

type surfaceEnv struct {
	t        *testing.T
	embedded *finality.Pins
}

func (e *surfaceEnv) registry(name string, without bool) *finality.Registry {
	switch name {
	case "fake_base":
		return baseRegistry()
	case "empty":
		return finality.NewRegistry()
	case "all":
		reg := finality.NewRegistry()
		if without {
			for _, r := range []func(*finality.Registry) error{adiri.Register, baseposted.Register, basefinal.Register, arbposted.Register} {
				if err := r(reg); err != nil {
					e.t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			return reg
		}
		if err := allkinds.Register(reg); err != nil {
			e.t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return reg
	}
	e.t.Fatalf("registry %s", name)
	return nil
}

// runDoc judges doc (a file) with reportFinalityFile; the temporary path is replaced by DOC.
func runDoc(t *testing.T, doc []byte, reg *finality.Registry, pins *finality.Pins, leg *legSettlement) genRun {
	t.Helper()
	dir := t.TempDir()
	p := filepath.Join(dir, "doc.json")
	if err := os.WriteFile(p, doc, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var out bytes.Buffer
	code := reportFinalityFile(&out, p, reg, pins, leg)
	return genRun{Exit: code, Text: strings.ReplaceAll(out.String(), p, "DOC")}
}

func writeJSON(t *testing.T, path string, v any) {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func sha(b []byte) string { s := sha256.Sum256(b); return hex.EncodeToString(s[:]) }

func legPinsRaw(t *testing.T, name string) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	type bc struct {
		Pins string `json:"pins"`
	}
	read := func(parts ...string) []byte { return readFileT(t, filepath.Join(append([]string{"..", ".."}, parts...)...)) }
	switch {
	case strings.HasPrefix(name, "base_posted_"):
		id := map[string]string{"base_posted_a": "valid_a", "base_posted_b": "valid_b"}[name]
		dir := filepath.Join("pkg", "finality", "baseposted", "testdata", "finality_base_posted1")
		var c bc
		if err := json.Unmarshal(read(dir, "cases", id+".json"), &c); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		raw, err := baseposted.SupplyBaseSepoliaPins(read(dir, c.Pins), baseposted.PublishedSetPinSupply)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return raw
	case strings.HasPrefix(name, "base_final_"):
		id := "valid_leg_" + strings.TrimPrefix(name, "base_final_")
		dir := filepath.Join("pkg", "finality", "basefinal", "testdata", "finality_base_final1")
		var c bc
		if err := json.Unmarshal(read(dir, "cases", id+".json"), &c); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return read(dir, c.Pins)
	case name == "arb_posted":
		dir := filepath.Join("pkg", "finality", "arbposted", "testdata", "finality_arb_posted1")
		var c bc
		if err := json.Unmarshal(read(dir, "cases", "valid_live.json"), &c); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return read(dir, c.Pins)
	case name == "arb_final_real":
		dir := filepath.Join("pkg", "finality", "arbfinal", "testdata", "finality_arb_final1")
		var set struct {
			Vectors []struct {
				Name string `json:"name"`
				Pins string `json:"pins"`
			} `json:"vectors"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(read(dir, "vectors.json"), &set); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for _, v := range set.Vectors {
			if v.Name == "real_valid" {
				return synthworld.WithWalletPins(read(dir, "pins", v.Pins))
			}
		}
	default:
		set := "finality_eth_sepolia1"
		base := name
		if strings.HasSuffix(name, "_root_anchored") {
			set = "finality_eth_sepolia2"
			base = strings.TrimSuffix(name, "_root_anchored")
		}
		id := map[string]string{"eth_gloas_latest": "valid_gloas_latest", "eth_gloas_period": "valid_gloas_period", "eth_legacy": "valid_legacy"}[base]
		dir := filepath.Join("pkg", "finality", "ethsepolia", "testdata", set)
		var c bc
		if err := json.Unmarshal(read(dir, "cases", id+".json"), &c); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return read(dir, c.Pins)
	}
	t.Fatalf("no pins for %s", name)
	return nil
}

var settlementByName map[string]*legSettlement

func mustMarshal(t *testing.T, v any) string {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(b)
}

func mustAddendum(t *testing.T, s finality.Settlement, l e2eLeg) finality.Addendum {
	t.Helper()
	pid := uuid.MustParse("01020304-0506-4708-8910-111213141516")
	a, err := finality.NewAddendum(finality.LegBindingOf(s.Block()), pid, nil, l.chain, l.level, l.kind, l.evidence)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s: %v", l.name, err)
	}
	return a
}

func TestZZSurfaceGen(t *testing.T) {
	outDir := os.Getenv("SURFACE_OUT")
	if outDir == "" {
		t.Fatal("SURFACE_OUT names the output directory of the generator")
	}
	for _, d := range []string{"settlements", "pins"} {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(outDir, d), 0o755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	env := &surfaceEnv{t: t}
	var err error
	if env.embedded, err = finality.EmbeddedPins(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	pinsByName := map[string]*finality.Pins{"embedded": env.embedded}
	var cases []genCase
	add := func(c genCase) {
		reg := env.registry(c.Registry, false)
		regW := env.registry(c.Registry, true)
		pins := pinsByName[c.Pins]
		if pins == nil {
			t.Fatalf("pins %s", c.Pins)
		}
		var leg *legSettlement
		if c.Settlement != "" {
			leg = settlementByName[c.Settlement]
			if leg == nil {
				t.Fatalf("settlement %s", c.Settlement)
			}
			c.Chain = fmt.Sprint(leg.chain)
		}
		c.ExpectAll = runDoc(t, []byte(c.Doc), reg, pins, leg)
		c.ExpectWithout = runDoc(t, []byte(c.Doc), regW, pins, leg)
		if len(c.Doc) > 100000 {
			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(outDir, "docs"), 0o755); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			c.DocFile = "docs/" + strings.NewReplacer("/", "__").Replace(strings.SplitN(c.ID, "/", 3)[1]) + ".json"
			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(outDir, c.DocFile), []byte(c.Doc), 0o644); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			c.Doc = ""
		}
		cases = append(cases, c)
	}

	// ---- settlement sources ----
	settlementByName = map[string]*legSettlement{}
	type sfile struct {
		Name       string `json:"name"`
		Chain      int64  `json:"chain"`
		Settlement any    `json:"settlement"`
	}
	exportSettlement := func(name string, chain uint64, s any, raw []byte) {
		if raw == nil {
			b, err := json.MarshalIndent(sfile{Name: name, Chain: int64(chain), Settlement: s}, "", " ")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			raw = append(b, '\n')
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(outDir, "settlements", name+".json"), raw, 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	base := finalitytest.Settlement(t, "base_sepolia_47368146")
	adir := finalitytest.Settlement(t, "telcoin_adiri_498759")
	settlementByName["base_sepolia_47368146"] = &legSettlement{chain: finality.ChainBaseSepolia, s: base.Included, source: "test"}
	settlementByName["telcoin_adiri_498759"] = &legSettlement{chain: finality.ChainBaseSepolia, s: adir.Included, source: "test"}
	exportSettlement("base_sepolia_47368146", base.Chain, base.Included, nil)
	exportSettlement("telcoin_adiri_498759", adir.Chain, adir.Included, nil)
	outcomeLeg, err := settlementFromOutcomeFile(fixturePath(84532))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	settlementByName["outcome_84532"] = outcomeLeg
	exportSettlement("outcome_84532", outcomeLeg.chain, outcomeLeg.s, nil)

	// ---- A: the cases of finality_test.go ----
	pid := uuid.MustParse("01020304-0506-4708-8910-111213141516")
	section := func(s finality.Settlement, levels ...finality.Level) finality.Section {
		return finality.NewSection(s.Block(), chainFor(t, s, pid, finality.LegBindingOf(s.Block()), levels...))
	}
	docOf := func(member any) string {
		raw, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"format": "certen-proof-v2-accumulate-portable/1", "finality": member})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return string(raw)
	}
	good := section(base, finality.LevelL1Posted, finality.LevelFinalized)
	one := section(base, finality.LevelL1Posted)
	oneFin := section(base, finality.LevelFinalized)
	add(genCase{ID: "go/no_settlement_named", Family: "finality_test.go TestFinalityFileNamesWhyItJudgesNothing", Doc: docOf(oneFin), Registry: "empty", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/no_section", Family: "finality_test.go", Doc: `{"format":"certen-proof-v2-accumulate-portable/1"}`, Registry: "empty", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/section_null", Family: "finality_test.go", Doc: `{"format":"certen-proof-v2-accumulate-portable/1","finality":null}`, Registry: "empty", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/top_level_null", Family: "encoding/json", Doc: `null`, Registry: "empty", Pins: "embedded"})
	oldFlat, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"finality": good.Addenda})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/old_flat_array", Family: "finality_test.go", Doc: string(oldFlat), Registry: "empty", Pins: "embedded"})
	badDigest, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"finality": map[string]any{"format": "certen-finality-addenda/1", "originalProofDigest": "00", "addenda": []any{}}})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/withdrawn_member", Family: "finality_test.go", Doc: string(badDigest), Registry: "empty", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/not_a_document_array", Family: "finality_test.go", Doc: `[1,2]`, Registry: "empty", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/not_json", Family: "encoding/json", Doc: `{`, Registry: "empty", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/empty_input", Family: "encoding/json", Doc: ``, Registry: "empty", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/case_folded_member", Family: "encoding/json", Doc: strings.Replace(docOf(oneFin), `"finality"`, `"FINALITY"`, 1), Registry: "empty", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/member_last_wins", Family: "encoding/json", Doc: `{"finality":null,"finality":` + mustMarshal(t, oneFin) + `}`, Registry: "empty", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/member_null_after", Family: "encoding/json", Doc: `{"finality":` + mustMarshal(t, oneFin) + `,"finality":null}`, Registry: "empty", Pins: "embedded"})

	add(genCase{ID: "go/chain_verifies_to_finalized", Family: "finality_test.go TestFinalityFileIsJudgedAgainstTheNamedSettlement", Doc: docOf(good), Settlement: "base_sepolia_47368146", Registry: "fake_base", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/one_level_l1_posted", Family: "finality_test.go", Doc: docOf(one), Settlement: "base_sepolia_47368146", Registry: "fake_base", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/one_level_finalized", Family: "finality_test.go", Doc: docOf(oneFin), Settlement: "base_sepolia_47368146", Registry: "fake_base", Pins: "embedded"})
	bad := good
	bad.Leg.BlockNumber++
	add(genCase{ID: "go/altered_leg_member", Family: "finality_test.go", Doc: docOf(bad), Settlement: "base_sepolia_47368146", Registry: "fake_base", Pins: "embedded"})
	other := base.Block()
	other.Number++
	forged := finality.NewSection(base.Block(), chainFor(t, base, pid, finality.LegBindingOf(other), finality.LevelFinalized))
	add(genCase{ID: "go/forged_d0", Family: "finality_test.go", Doc: docOf(forged), Settlement: "base_sepolia_47368146", Registry: "fake_base", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/unknown_kinds_summary_only", Family: "finality_test.go", Doc: docOf(good), Settlement: "base_sepolia_47368146", Registry: "empty", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/settlement_of_another_block", Family: "finality_test.go", Doc: docOf(good), Settlement: "telcoin_adiri_498759", Registry: "fake_base", Pins: "embedded"})
	outcomeS := finality.Settlement{Chain: outcomeLeg.chain, Included: outcomeLeg.s}
	outcomeS.Subject, _ = finality.SubjectOfSettlement(outcomeLeg.s)
	outBlock, err := finality.DeriveIncluded(outcomeLeg.chain, outcomeLeg.s)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	osec := finality.NewSection(outBlock, chainFor(t, outcomeS, pid, finality.LegBindingOf(outBlock), finality.LevelL1Posted))
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"finality": osec})
	add(genCase{ID: "go/outcome_file_settlement", Family: "finality_test.go TestFinalityFileSettlementFromAnExportedOutcomeEvidenceFile", Doc: string(raw), Settlement: "outcome_84532", Registry: "fake_base", Pins: "embedded"})

	// extra rules of the chain/framework judged through the document path
	tw := func(f func(s *finality.Section)) string {
		s := section(base, finality.LevelL1Posted, finality.LevelFinalized)
		f(&s)
		return docOf(s)
	}
	add(genCase{ID: "extra/seq_gap", Family: "report path", Doc: tw(func(s *finality.Section) { s.Addenda[1].Seq = 3 }), Settlement: "base_sepolia_47368146", Registry: "fake_base", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "extra/prev_hash", Family: "report path", Doc: tw(func(s *finality.Section) { s.Addenda[1].PrevHash[0] ^= 1 }), Settlement: "base_sepolia_47368146", Registry: "fake_base", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "extra/level_duplicate", Family: "report path", Doc: tw(func(s *finality.Section) { s.Addenda = append(s.Addenda, s.Addenda[0]) }), Settlement: "base_sepolia_47368146", Registry: "fake_base", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "extra/empty_chain", Family: "report path", Doc: tw(func(s *finality.Section) { s.Addenda = nil }), Settlement: "base_sepolia_47368146", Registry: "fake_base", Pins: "embedded"})
	settlementByName["base_as_chain_1"] = &legSettlement{chain: 1, s: base.Included, source: "test"}
	exportSettlement("base_as_chain_1", 1, base.Included, nil)
	add(genCase{ID: "extra/chain_1_unsupported", Family: "report path", Doc: docOf(good), Settlement: "base_as_chain_1", Registry: "fake_base", Pins: "embedded"})
	badS := *base.Included
	badS.TxHash[0] ^= 1
	settlementByName["base_tx_hash_flipped"] = &legSettlement{chain: finality.ChainBaseSepolia, s: &badS, source: "test"}
	exportSettlement("base_tx_hash_flipped", base.Chain, &badS, nil)
	add(genCase{ID: "extra/settlement_does_not_verify", Family: "report path", Doc: docOf(good), Settlement: "base_tx_hash_flipped", Registry: "fake_base", Pins: "embedded"})
	add(genCase{ID: "extra/pending_not_applicable", Family: "report path", Doc: docOf(one), Settlement: "base_sepolia_47368146", Registry: "all", Pins: "embedded"})

	// ---- B: the e2e legs with their REAL evidence ----
	for _, l := range e2eLegs(t) {
		file := l.settle
		if file == "" {
			file = l.name
		}
		s := settlementOf(t, l)
		rawFile := readFileT(t, filepath.Join(e2eData, file+".json"))
		if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(outDir, "settlements", file+".json")); err != nil {
			exportSettlement(file, s.Chain, nil, rawFile)
		}
		settlementByName[file] = &legSettlement{chain: s.Chain, s: s.Included, source: "test"}
		praw := legPinsRaw(t, l.name)
		pp, err := finality.ParsePinsOverride(praw)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if pp.SHA256() != l.pins.SHA256() {
			t.Fatalf("%s: pins bytes differ from the leg's pins", l.name)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(outDir, "pins", l.name+".json"), praw, 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		pinsByName[l.name] = pp
		sec := finality.NewSection(s.Block(), []finality.Addendum{mustAddendum(t, s, l)})
		add(genCase{ID: "e2e/" + l.name + "/vector_pins", Family: "finality_e2e_pos_test.go", Doc: docOf(sec), Settlement: file, Registry: "all", Pins: l.name, Kind: l.kind})
		add(genCase{ID: "e2e/" + l.name + "/embedded_pins", Family: "finality_e2e_pos_test.go", Doc: docOf(sec), Settlement: file, Registry: "all", Pins: "embedded", Kind: l.kind})
	}
	writeJSON(t, filepath.Join(outDir, "cases.json"), map[string]any{"cases": cases})

	// ---- C: printReport over synthetic reports (finality_pins_class_test.go and the rest of printReport's branches) ----
	h := strings.Repeat("ab", 32)
	mk := func(levels map[string]synthLevel, headline string) synthReport {
		return synthReport{Chain: 11155111, Number: 1, Hash: h, Levels: levels, Headline: headline, PinsSHA: "00ff", PinsSource: "embedded"}
	}
	ver := synthLevel{Status: "verified"}
	st := func(code string, kv ...any) *synthState {
		f := map[string]any{}
		for i := 0; i < len(kv); i += 2 {
			f[kv[i].(string)] = kv[i+1]
		}
		return &synthState{Code: code, Fields: f}
	}
	refused := func(s *synthState) synthLevel { return synthLevel{Status: "refused", State: s} }
	pending := synthLevel{Status: "pending", State: st("finality_pending", "level", "included", "reason", "no_evidence_in_file", "chain", 84532, "pending", "l1_posted")}
	na := synthLevel{Status: "level_not_applicable", State: st("finality_level_not_applicable", "chain", 1, "level", "l1_posted")}
	var synth []genSynth
	addSynth := func(id, note string, r synthReport) {
		var out bytes.Buffer
		code := printReport(&out, toReport(r), "leg")
		synth = append(synth, genSynth{ID: id, Note: note, Report: r, Expect: genRun{Exit: code, Text: out.String()}})
	}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		name string
		st   *synthState
	}{
		{"ledger_behind", st("finality_ledger_behind", "needed_period", 1391, "ledger_head_period", 1378)},
		{"pin_unknown", st("finality_pin_unknown", "period", 1300)},
		{"unrecognised_kind", st("finality_evidence_unrecognised", "kind", "x/y/v9", "version", "v9")},
		{"wrapped_ledger_behind", st("l1_finality_unproven", "reason", "lc_refused", "inner", "finality_ledger_behind")},
		{"wrapped_pin_unknown", st("l1_finality_unproven", "reason", "lc_refused", "inner", "finality_pin_unknown")},
		{"wrapped_signature", st("l1_finality_unproven", "reason", "lc_refused", "inner", "finality_signature_invalid")},
		{"signature_invalid", st("finality_signature_invalid", "index", 0)},
		{"pin_mismatch", st("finality_pin_mismatch", "period", 1378)},
		{"wrapper_without_inner", st("l1_finality_unproven", "reason", "lc_refused")},
		{"no_state_at_all", nil},
	} {
		lv := refused(c.st)
		addSynth("class/"+c.name, "finality_pins_class_test.go", mk(map[string]synthLevel{"included": ver, "finalized": lv}, "included"))
	}
	addSynth("branch/verified_finalized", "printReport", mk(map[string]synthLevel{"included": ver, "l1_posted": ver, "finalized": ver}, "finalized"))
	{
		r := mk(map[string]synthLevel{"included": ver, "l1_posted": ver, "finalized": ver}, "finalized")
		r.FinBlock = &synthFinBlock{Number: 7, Hash: strings.Repeat("cd", 32), StateRoot: strings.Repeat("ef", 32)}
		addSynth("branch/verified_finalized_with_finalized_block", "printReport", r)
		r2 := r
		r2.FinBlockSt = st("finality_finalized_block_unavailable", "chain", 11155111, "reason", "no_header")
		addSynth("branch/finalized_block_state", "printReport", r2)
	}
	addSynth("branch/pending_and_na", "printReport", mk(map[string]synthLevel{"included": ver, "l1_posted": pending, "finalized": na}, "included"))
	{
		r := mk(map[string]synthLevel{}, "none")
		r.Unsupported = st("finality_chain_unsupported", "chain", 1)
		addSynth("branch/unsupported", "printReport", r)
	}
	addSynth("branch/included_refused", "printReport", mk(map[string]synthLevel{"included": refused(st("finality_included_invalid", "chain", 84532, "cause", "x"))}, "none"))
	{
		r := mk(map[string]synthLevel{"included": ver, "l1_posted": refused(st("finality_chain_broken", "seq", 1, "check", "own_hash")), "finalized": refused(st("finality_chain_broken", "seq", 1, "check", "own_hash"))}, "included")
		r.Broken = st("finality_chain_broken", "seq", 1, "check", "own_hash")
		addSynth("branch/broken", "printReport", r)
	}
	addSynth("branch/mixed_failed_and_summary", "worseExit", mk(map[string]synthLevel{"included": ver, "l1_posted": refused(st("finality_pin_unknown", "period", 1)), "finalized": refused(st("finality_signature_invalid", "index", 2))}, "included"))
	addSynth("branch/mixed_summary_after_failed", "worseExit", mk(map[string]synthLevel{"included": ver, "l1_posted": refused(st("finality_signature_invalid", "index", 2)), "finalized": refused(st("finality_pin_unknown", "period", 1))}, "included"))
	writeJSON(t, filepath.Join(outDir, "synthetic.json"), map[string]any{"reports": synth})

	fmt.Printf("SURFACE-GEN cases=%d synthetic=%d sha(cases)=%s\n", len(cases), len(synth), sha([]byte(fmt.Sprint(len(cases)))))
}
